Nearly figured out the final list for Ace 📝

I was convinced running Buckin 'the nanny' was bait. 
I owe this card an apology.

Running 4 in Rocks now and she's been perfect — it allows you to stabilise easier in the early game and lets you counter out of gimmicky attack sequences from the opponent. 

The stage, on the other hand, is way worse than it looks. Cut it and never looked back.

I know I'm late to it, but better late than never.

Still can't get my head around the Mihawk matchup, just hoping on the fact that he folds to Yellow and Red to make him less relevant in the format. 

For the rest, the Rocks feels extremely stable and able to manage every matchup with different tools. 

Can't wait to play OP17

FxTwitter returns individual tweets when an ID is known, but not user timelines. DuckDuckGo site:x.com often 202s or returns older tweets that ignore since:. Nitter/xcancel/syndication/RSSHub did not yield timelines. List photos that *are* public (The_Egman 2089838271522320522 on 2026-08-18, Yonxlj Ace 2086756739634909242 on 2026-08-10, KuroKumaTCG Rocks 2084578215536816418 on 2026-08-04) are outside the two-day window and were not hosted.

Hosted 4 complete 50-card lists from @Chinoize_ 2092357744921612794 (ChinoizeCup #101 top 4 photos, 2026-08-25). Card IDs taken from the matching Limitless standings, not from screenshot OCR. @ONEPIECE_tcg_EN LATAM Santiago graphics (2092160093517160585) are also in-window list photos, but overlay OCR did not produce a trustworthy 50-card ID dump so those were not hosted.
